Program Branding, Communications & Fundraising - 20%

Leads the development and implementation of a brand presence (i.e., web presence, print and electronic media, participation in conferences, meetings, social media etc.) for a) promotion and publicity, b) dissemination of projects, and c) knowledge sharing and networking
Supports the implementation, in cooperation with the IEEE Foundation, of an effective and multi-faceted communications plan for EPICS in IEEE that integrates into the IEEE Foundation’s overall communications and marketing plans
Identifies, plans for and represents IEEE and EPICS in IEEE at relevant venues and events around the globe

Data Analysis and Reporting - 15%

Develops, maintains, collects, analyzes and reports quantitative and qualitative program metrics and evaluations criteria, in cooperation with IEEE Research, and recommends changes to enhance the program, as appropriate
Ensures the program has a sound business plan, operates within the approved budget and timeline, and all financial records are up to date.
Responsible for preparation of compelling and persuasive presentations and reports, IEEE & IEEE Foundation Boards, Committees, IEEE Leadership on program activities

Positive, proactive work attitude

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement, Vendor Operations
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Organization Summary

At Global Vendor Delivery & Solutions (GVDS), we are transforming how Microsoft delivers business operations at scale. As part of MBO (Microsoft Business Operations), GVDS combines operational excellence, AI-powered innovation, and strategic partnerships to create secure, scalable, and high-performing services across a global vendor ecosystem.

As Microsoft evolves toward a Frontier Firm model, AI, automation, and agentic systems are reshaping how work gets done. GVDS plays a critical role in enabling that transformation by helping operations become more intelligent, adaptive, and outcome-focused. We are looking for leaders who can challenge legacy approaches, accelerate adoption of AI-first ways of working, and build sustainable systems that continuously improve customer and business outcomes.

Role Summary

The AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead is responsible for embedding a culture of continuous improvement across Vendor Operations while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled operating models. This role serves as a strategic bridge between operations, engineering, service design, and vendor partners to identify opportunities for transformation, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role requires equal parts transformational leadership, operational excellence, and change management. The ideal candidate will build scalable improvement systems, champion AI-driven innovation, and advance Vendor Operations toward a Frontier Firm model that delivers greater quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and business value.

This is not a traditional Continuous Improvement role focused solely on Lean methodologies. It is a transformation leadership role responsible for helping redefine how operations are designed, executed, measured, and continuously optimized in an AI-first world.

Responsibilities

Capability Portfolio Ownership & Feature Management

Own the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, business cases, implementation governance, adoption, benefits realization, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of artificial intelligence-driven operational capabilities.
Maintain accountability beyond deployment to ensure capabilities continue to evolve and deliver measurable business outcomes.

AI Transformation & Frontier Firm Enablement

Lead the adoption of AI-first and agentic operating models across Vendor Operations.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve decision-making through AI-enabled workflows.
Partner with engineering, service design, and operations teams to scale AI and automation capabilities.
Drive operational readiness for Microsoft's Frontier Firm vision.

Continuous Improvement System Deployment

Establish and scale continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations using Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Lean, or other structured problem-solving methodologies.
Build repeatable improvement frameworks that create sustainable operational gains.
Facilitate cross-functional improvement initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
Ensure improvements are standardized and institutionalized through governance and operational rhythms.

Operational Excellence & Performance Management

Define and track metrics that reflect customer value, operational efficiency, quality, productivity, and adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.
Develop performance insights that enable leaders to prioritize investments and improvement opportunities.
Create visibility into operational health and transformation progress through data-driven reporting.

Change Management & Organizational Adoption

Lead adoption strategies for new capabilities, operating models, tools, and ways of working, using stakeholder feedback and performance data to guide ongoing capability improvements.
Partner with stakeholders to remove barriers and accelerate behavioral change.
Ensure improvements transition from pilots to sustainable business practices.
Build organizational capability for continuous learning and improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Serve as a trusted advisor to Vendor Operations leaders on transformation priorities and continuous improvement strategy.
Align stakeholders across Vendor Operations, Engineering, Service Design, and broader MBO initiatives.
Foster knowledge sharing and reuse of best practices across the vendor ecosystem.
Drive organizational alignment around operational excellence and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 4+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of experience leading operational transformation, continuous improvement, or business process optimization initiatives in complex global organizations.
Demonstrated success driving measurable improvements in quality, productivity, customer experience, or operational efficiency.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills with experience defining and managing operational performance metrics.
Proven ability to influence organizational boundaries and lead without direct authority. Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience owning a portfolio of operational capabilities or features, including strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, business case development, implementation governance, adoption, and benefits realization.
Experience deploying AI, automation, or agentic solutions within operational environments.
Experience implementing structured improvement methodologies such as Lean, PDCA, Kaizen, or related frameworks.
Knowledge of vendor operations, outsourcing models, or large-scale service delivery organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering, product, or service design teams on transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and AI governance considerations.
Certification or experience in Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement disciplines.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Adoption and scalability of continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations.
Increased AI-enabled automation and reduction of manual effort.
Improvements in customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated business impact from transformation initiatives.
Increased organizational capability and adoption of AI-first ways of working.
Establishment of sustainable operational excellence and governance practices.
Contribution toward the evolution of Vendor Operations into a Frontier Firm operating model.

Business Program Management IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $97,600 - $188,400 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $125,000 - $206,400 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager – Army Analytics and Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About The Position

Dexis is recruiting a highly qualified Senior Program Manager
to lead and coordinate professional services support for an opportunity with the Army
focusing on operations analysis, modeling, simulation, tools and scenario development, wargaming, experimentation, technical reporting, and security and facility support.

The Senior PM is responsible for ensuring all contract requirements, task orders, and performance standards are met across program locations, while maintaining effective coordination with the Government’s Contracting Officer (KO) and Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR).

This position is based in White Sands Missile Range, NM or Fort Bliss TX and is contingent upon contract award. Top Secret Clearance is required.

Responsibilities

Oversee the day-to-day administration of the contract and manage the relationship with the client
Plan, direct, and oversee execution of all task orders supporting the Army's Analysis Center’s analytical, engineering, modeling and simulation, scenario development, technical reports, and security support missions.
Ensure deliverables, products, services, and personnel meet government needs and expectations
Participate in post-award conferences, coordination meetings, technical reviews, and periodic progress meetings.
Provide monthly contract progress briefings and written status reports in accordance with Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs).
Proactively identify risks, issues, and performance concerns and implement corrective actions in coordination with the Government.
Develop, implement, and maintain an effective Quality Control Plan (QCP) ensuring all services and deliverables meet contract performance standards.
Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant delivery of all contract outputs, including analytical products, reports, and program documentation.

Qualifications

10 years minimum experience
5 years of experience as a PM for contracts supporting the U.S. Army
5 years of experience in operations analysis, wargaming, and tools development
3 years as a U.S. Government contractor
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
Experience creating stability and security for large teams
Top Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Service with the Army or another branch of the Military
10 years of PM experience
10 years of operations analysis, wargaming, and tools development
10 years of management experience, leading multi-disciplined teams of analysts, and other personnel
Demonstrated experience with risk mitigation planning
Strategic, big picture thinker
Familiarity supporting growth of the employer with U.S. Government contracts

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

If you are passionate about this opportunity, apply now!

Only those applicants who meet the above criteria will be contacted for interview.

Dexis is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, pregnancy, disability, age, genetic information, military service, veteran status, ethnicity, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, childbirth and related medical conditions, including lactation, or any other protected class under applicable law.

As part of a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, Dexis provides healthcare insurance in addition to other staff welfare benefits and perks.
